item.title: FWP publishes 2026 hunting regulations
item.description: The 2026 "deer, elk, antelope" and "moose, sheep, goat, bison" hunting regulations are available from Montana Fish, Wildlife, and Parks. As with every year, there are changes hunters should know.

item.title: East Helena Police will continue to work as a part of the Missouri River Drug Task Force
item.description: The East Helena Police Department will continue to be part of the Missouri River Drug Task Force. The East Helena City Council voted in favor of the new memorandum at their January 20th meeting.

item.title: Helena protesters speak out on immigration enforcement
item.description: Protesters gathered outside the federal courthouse in Helena on Wednesday night to call out immigration enforcement practices following the recent deaths of Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minneapolis.
